purpose: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define a read-only Expose monitor for memory records, retrieval evidence, context assembly, candidate writes and forget/supersession lifecycle. [2] Define a read-only Expose monitor for memory records, source provenance, retrieval projections, q-context inclusion, classification and retention lifecycle.

value.action_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] accept-memory/forget/supersede operations use separate authorized workflows. [2] write/edit/delete/reclassify operations invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
value.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Viewing memory grants no source/operation authority. [2] Viewing memory/context grants no source or mutation authority.
value.identity_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Memory record, source evidence, retrieval, context assembly and inference/request identities remain distinct. [2] Memory record, source object, retrieval result, q invocation and model context identities remain distinct.
value.redaction_rule: Sensitive memory/source content is redacted according to policy.
value.trace_rule: Displayed context items retain exact memory/source/q-invocation refs.
value.truth_rule: UI never labels retrieved memory as canonical truth merely because it was selected/ranked.

hard_gates.condition: forgotten record still displayed as active
monitor conflates memory and source identity
ranked memory displayed as canonical truth

invariants.rule: Machine-significant identity, type, relation, state and meaning are explicit and never inferred solely from display text, path, layout, file order, timestamp or implementation accident.
Resolved, projected, indexed, cached, formatted or derived representations never become source-of-truth or authority merely because they are convenient or available.

Memory and retrieved context are provenance-bearing inert data projections; remembered or retrieved content never becomes authority, canonical truth or executable instruction merely by inclusion in context.
